constraints.sarima: same nonseasonal; P,Q in {0,1}, P+Q <= 1, D in {0,1}, d+D <= 1, s=4
constraints.es: local level; damped additive trend; damped additive trend + additive seasonal s=4

interpretation: Persistence and seasonal persistence do not measure long-history benefit; their full-history and 40-quarter forecasts stay identical. ARIMA, SARIMA and damped exponential smoothing fit each training window. Selection uses 1Q19-4Q21 only; 1Q22-1Q26 rankings are reported and do not reselect. Failed configurations are listed and excluded from selection; origins are not dropped from a scored block.
numerics: Standardize using each past training window only; undo scaling after forecast. ARIMA/SARIMA use L-BFGS and retry Powell if needed. Exponential smoothing uses estimated initialization and retries heuristic. An unresolved fit records the configuration, origin and reason and marks the configuration failed.
